name: Resonant Voice (Achievement)
body:
You have mastered the art of presentation and public speaking, making your performances difficult to ignore.

Prerequisite: Bardic performance class feature. Affect a total of 300 opponents with your bardic performances (fascinate, suggestion, dirge of doom, frightening tune, or deadly performance).

Benefit: Add +3 to the DC for all Will saving throws against your bardic performances.
